create.description: Keigan creates the application as a draft and shows the two AD groups to request in SailPoint.
create.requestDescription: A Keigan admin reviews your request and starts the onboarding.
create.name: Application name

create.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 10 upper-case letters or digits.

team.title: Team (optional)
team.description: Add the people who work on this application. They receive an invitation email that tells them which group to request for access. You can change the team later.
team.descriptionRequest: Add the people who work on this application. Nobody is emailed until Keigan admins accept the request; you can invite them then.
team.name: Name
team.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
team.addedListedOnly_one: {{count}} person was added to the team. Nobody is emailed until the request is accepted.
team.addedListedOnly_other: {{count}} people were added to the team. Nobody is emailed until the request is accepted.

create.failed: The application could not be created. Try again.
create.groupsIntro: Request membership of these AD groups in SailPoint so people can see and manage the application.
create.sailpointHint: Groups are provisioned through SailPoint into Entra ID, which can take a short while.

operatingNotes.title: Operating notes for the AI
operatingNotes.description: A short note from your team that the AI reads in every investigation and chat for this application.
operatingNotes.label: Operating notes
operatingNotes.helper: Write what telemetry cannot tell the AI: which services carry revenue or regulated traffic, which alerts are usually noise, what normal looks like on a quiet night, who to mention. It is guidance, not evidence: the AI still has to cite real evidence, and these notes do not change alert rules or noise policy. Do not write passwords or personal data.
operatingNotes.placeholder: For example: Claim submission carries regulated traffic. The 02:00 batch makes the database busy and that is normal. A quiet night is about 40 requests an hour. Mention the duty manager for payment questions.
operatingNotes.empty: Nobody has written operating notes yet.
operatingNotes.readOnly: Only this application's admins can edit these notes.
operatingNotes.overLimit: {{excess}} characters over the limit. Shorten the notes to save.
operatingNotes.neverEdited: Nobody has edited these notes yet.
operatingNotes.savedBody: The AI uses them from the next investigation or chat.
operatingNotes.saveFailed: That did not work. Try again.
operatingNotes.leaveBody: Your changes to the operating notes will be lost.

components.label: Components
components.description: Tell Keigan where the application runs: Azure, hardware, mainframe or SaaS.

services.label: Services
services.description: The units Keigan monitors. Review what was discovered and add the rest.

log_tools.label: Log and monitoring tools
log_tools.description: Connect Elastic, Splunk, Datadog and other tools once and reuse them across services.

knowledge.label: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: Let Copilot write the code context, then upload it with architecture diagrams and guides.

topology.label: Topology review
topology.description: Check Keigan's picture of how the services connect. Review it, do not approve it.

runbooks.label: Runbooks
runbooks.description: Known issues and the team's documented response, matched to future incidents.

incidents.label: Incidents and alerts
incidents.description: Where incidents and alerts for this application come from.

slo.label: SLOs
slo.description: Reliability targets Keigan measures from the data it can read.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Who hears about incidents, in which channel and language.

access.label: Access
access.description: The AD groups that control who can see and manage this application.
